instructions: To pick up a draggable item, press the space bar. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move the item. Press space again to drop the item, or press escape to cancel.
over: Draggable item {{id}} was moved over droppable area {{over}}.
outside: Draggable item {{id}} is no longer over a droppable area.
end: Draggable item {{id}} was dropped over droppable area {{over}}.
cancel: Dragging was cancelled. Draggable item {{id}} was dropped.
